name: Betty
description: This ship is used by the Mido as an interplanetary shuttle. It's small, lightweight and relatively fast, but it's definitely not something a pilot should attempt to take into a fight.

name: Teneta
description: A heavy Terran rocket ship equipped with four secondary slots and room for a gun turret. It's a good deal because it's a bit older and doesn't have all the bells and whistles of a modern ship.

name: Hiro
description: A modified version of the Terran Inflict. At the expense of a primary weapons slot it has two secondary weapon slots installed.

name: Badger
description: The Badger is a solid ship built by the Mido. With primary and secondary weapons slots, it can be a formidable opponent.

name: Dace
description: The Nivelian have crafted the most agile ship ever built, the Dace. The cargo space is quite small and has limited space for modules. It makes up for this with the ability to fire four primary weapons simultaneously.

name: Inflict
description: The Terran fleet's most popular fighter. Cheap to manufacture and great looking.

name: Hector
description: The Mido regularly use the Hector as a light reconnaissance vehicle, and it is often found patrolling border areas. They are not very robust, and rarely used in combat.

name: Anaan
description: This ship is often used to transport expensive goods or important politicians. It has a large cargo space and can handle itself when it comes to combat.

name: VoidX
description: This Void fighter was immobilized and transported intact to Thynome, where it was modified for human pilots. No information has even been released about what happened to the original pilot.

name: H'Soc
description: The heavily armored fighter built by the Vossk Empire. It is available on almost all Vossk stations and has been modified so that other species can pilot it.

name: Phantom
description: Reconstructed Hawk class model. The armour was strengthened and module capacities modified to give this retro vessel no problem keeping pace with newer models. The salesman is justifying the excessive price with this ship's uniqueness.

name: Hernstein
description: The Hernstein is a dangerous battleship and is particularly popular with wealthy mercenaries.

name: Type 43
description: This ship was designed as a lightweight rocket ship and is often used by the Nivelian armed forces in large battles. This model has been slightly scaled back for the civilian market.

name: Kinzer
description: A popular, customizable Nivelian ship, the Kinzer is equipped with the latest technology and can be personalized with a variety of modules.

name: Ward
description: The Ward is a powerful Terran-built assault ship. With its four primary weapon brackets and ten module slots, it is the perfect ship for most pilots.

name: Hatsuyuki
description: It has little in the way of cargo space, but the Hatsuyuki is agile, heavily armed and very customizable. A masterpiece of Nivelian engineering.

name: Nuyang II
description: The Nuyang II is an impressive ship. It is armed to the teeth, heavily armored and has plenty of room for cargo and modules. If you are looking for a Mido ship and you have the Credits, there is no better option.

name: Cicero
description: A good all-rounder. Solid, small and perfect for light reconnaissance missions or a weekend getaway.

name: Aegir
description: The Aegir is the Nivelian's flagship vessel. It is perfection, elegance and power all rolled into one. It is not a cheap ship by any means, but is highly sought after by a lot of pilots across the galaxy.

name: Groza
description: The Groza may not look like much, but it is a well-equipped and very dangerous ship. The large cargo space makes it a common choice among trigger-happy traders.

name: Azov
description: The Azov is essentially a "Groza Lite". Lighter, more agile, but also less dangerous and smaller than its big brother. It is still a very popular ship for mercenaries and pirates.

name: Velasco
description: A dangerous pirate assault ship. It has heavy weapons, space for a gun turret and a lot of open module bays, making this ship a serious threat to all travelers.

name: Tyrion
description: A favorite with mercenaries, this ship is often used to give support to other attack vehicles.

name: Hera
description: A relatively old Terran design, this ship is average in all respects, but some regard it as a classic.

name: Taipan
description: Like the Hera, the Taipan is more of a vintage offering than a practical choice. The ability to attach three primary weapons gives it a slight edge, however.

name: Veteran
description: Few pilots will ever get the chance to climb into the cockpit of a Veteran due to its prohibitive price. The expense is completely justified by the myriad arming and customization possibilities it offers.

name: Mantis
description: The Mantis is one of the largest and most dangerous ships on the market. Weapons, armor, modules - everything has been maxed out for this model. Only one ship per person please!

name: Berger CrossXT
description: After the Mido rebellion, the Berger firm saw a good business opportunity and unleashed the Berger Cross XT on the Mido System's open market. A balanced battle ship for a small budget, the ship sold well and a successor is already in the pipeline.

name: Salvéhn
description: Originally designed as a research vessel, the Salvéhn has been modified for the military. Officially this ship is still a secret and you can make a lot of money selling one around here.

name: Wasp
description: An extremely agile, small vessel for reconnaissance missions or to get from A to B in a hurry. It is not suitable for combat operations, however, due to its small module slots.

name: Furious
description: A light, basic Terran ship, made more appealing by the possibility of installing a turret.

name: Razor 6
description: The Razor 6 is the successor to the old Terran ship, the Zephyr. It has a greater emphasis on agility and weaponry, and there is only one cheaper ship with four mountable weapon brackets.

name: Night Owl
description: A flexible, small missile ship. Perfect for singletons with low expectations and who like to travel often.

name: Cormorant
description: The Cormorant is a very special ship. It has the largest cargo space and exceptionally strong armor. It is not possible to attach primary weapons but the existing gun turret provides ample defense.

name: Cronus
description: The Cronus is an extraordinary object. In contrast to traditional models, it draws its energy from a Perpetuum Mobile. The high asking price is to cover the cost of full-time psychiatric care for the many scientists who lost their minds while developing the ships energy system. This ship includes an integrated Khador drive.

name: Typhon
description: With a compact ship design and reduced cargo bay, the Typhon scores with its outstanding maneuverability. The ship's engines are fed by two perpetual generators that are located in the robust wing sections. This ship includes an integrated Khador drive.

name: S'Kanarr
description: With the S'Kanaar, the Vossk are bringing a heavily gunned battleship on the market, which has enough space for a turret in addition to four primary and two secondary weapons. Extremely heavy armour provides solid protection, although this means reduced maneuverability.

name: Nemesis
description: The Nemesis is the crown jewel of the Deep Science engineering arts. Heavily armed, well-protected and stylish, it is the perfect ship for the self-confident pilot with credits to spare. This ship includes an integrated Khador drive.

name: K'Suukk
description: At first glance, the features of the K'Suukk may seem similar to those of the H'Soc, but the improvements are in the details. In addition to stronger armour, the ship has space for an additional primary weapon and plenty of free module spaces.

name: Vol Noor
description: As a recon ship from one of the ancient Grey fleets, the Vol Noor has almost become a relic by now. At the beginning of the Vossk wars, the timeless design was still in common use, but the increasing demand for increased module spaces eventually made this model obsolete.

name: Wraith
description: Originally a Nivellian creation, the Wraith fighter has, in spite of its age, an excellent balance. Its high agility and its four primary weapon slots are worth noting.

name: Specter
description: The Specter is a flexible, extremely dangerous interceptor used by the Trunt Harval's black guard. It has a surprisingly large amount of equipment slots and a preinstalled U'tool cloaking device.

name: Bloodstar
description: The flying fortress of the wanted criminal Qyrr Myfft is the titanium-plated dream of every fighter pilot. With extremely powerful weapons, lots of cargo space, above-average armor and a turret pod, it is a true colossus of a vessel and one of the most destructive vessels in the entire galaxy!

name: Blue Fyre
description:
The Blue Fyre was designed by Tork Grant as a concept-study and was first
showcased at the Augmenta Space Ship Fair. The ship combines both Nivelian
and Terran design and merges functionality and elegance with substantial
fighting force. Besides arousing admiration, the ship also aroused desire,
and it didn’t take long until the prototype was stolen from the hangar by the fugitive criminal Urr Sakant.

name: Gator Custom
description: The Gator Custom is the signature ship of the Midorian space criminal Malon Sentendar. Originally the Gator Custom belonged to a notorious bounty hunter, but it was stolen by Sentendar after its former owner had parked it in the hangar of the Kaamo Club.

name: Amboss
description: The Amboss is quite a peculiar ship. Despite its small size, its creator Heinrich Wickel not only managed to cram an impressive weaponry into that vessel but also to equip it with an extremely strong titanium plating.

name: Scimitar
description: Trunt Harval's gunship. Despite its elegant look, the Scimitar contains a lot of equipment slots and an extremely strong armor. A U'tool cloaking device is preinstalled.
nothing

name: Rhino
description: The Terran Forces mostly use the Rhino in order to transport their infantry from one star system to another. Despite its limited maneuverability, the Rhino is very popular among traders due to its enormous cargo space.

name: Gryphon
description: The re-make of the old Gryphon, which was one of the most popular Terran ships during the Vossk Wars. Besides the elegant fighter's new paint job, the manufacturers have also put a lot of emphasis on an enhanced maneuverability.
nothing

name: Na'srrk
description: The Na'srrk is a new, heavily armed gunship made by the Vossk. This powerful craft is a good alternative for all pilots who cannot afford to buy a S'Kanarr and don't consider the availability of a turret pod a mandatory issue.

name: Groza Mk II
description: The Groza Mk II contains 5 primary weapon slots and tons of room for additional tools and gadgets. While the ship's cargo space is a bit smaller than that of its predecessor, its reinforced armour and increased handling do more than compensate for this shortcoming.

name: Berger Cross Special
description: A completely reconditioned version of one of the most popular space crafts of the Midorian space fleet. With four primary and four secondary weapon slots, the Berger Cross Special can take down just about any ship in the galaxy.

name: Kinzer RS
description: The flamboyant colouring of the Kinzer RS serves as a warning to all those foolish enough to engage with this high-tech fighter. Due to its strong armament and high number of equipment slots, the Kinzer RS is particularly hard to take down. Fortunately, its enemies can spot it from afar and program a course of evasion.

name: Phantom XT
description: The rusty but trusty Phantom is held in high regard by pilots from all over the universe. Hence, the Terran Forces have decided to build a follow-up model named the Phantom XT, which contains more room for primary weapons and equipment. However, space pilots who want to make use of these enhancements must be prepared to shell out a large sum of credits.

name: Teneta R.E.D.
description: While building the Teneta R.E.D., the engineers in charge not only traded two secondary weapons slots for two additional primary weapons slots, but also improved the vessel's armour and manoeuvrability. To round off the whole design, more equipment slots were also included.

name: Darkzov
description: Compared to the standard model, this special version of the Azov marks an improvement in almost every aspect. Strong armour plating, high fire-power and plenty of space for supplementary tools and gadgets are the main advantages of this rare collector's edition.

name: Ghost
description: The Ghost is the result of the Nivelians' efforts of building an agile yet heavily armored stealth fighter. Its experimental and unconventional design is the result of the various modifications, which have been added to the ship throughout the different phases of the development. However, according to the Midorian secret service, the technical expertise, which has been won during the development of the Ghost, has later on been used for another highly confidential project on the authority of a certain Trunt Harval - the military leader of the Nivelian Republic at that time.

name: Dark Angel
description: The Dark Angel is the prototype of a heavy gunship that had been developed by the Davilon Corporation, a Terran weapons manufacturer which is no longer around these days. Even though the Dark Angel appeared to be quite promising during its extensive testing phase, a number of delays and unscheduled development costs ultimately led to the dismissal of the project.

name: N'Tirrk
description: The Vossk military designed the N'Tirrk to be a swift interceptor, whose heavy armor and immense firepower were particularly well-suited to take down battle ships and freighters. The body of the N'Tirrk is equipped with an experimental segment plating, which gives the ship a particularly aggressive look. Despite its enormous capabilities, the slightly overpriced N'Tirrk had been dismissed in favour of the less expensive S'Kanarr. Nevertheless, the Vossk military council has kept open the option to start mass-production on the N'Tirrk whenever a bigger quantity of this powerful gunship is needed.
